text: I've been feeling okay recently, just normal day to day stuff. Nothing major to report.
Sometimes I get a bit stressed out when I think about the incident. It makes my heart beat faster and I feel uneasy, but I usually calm down after a while.
The nightmares are relentless. I wake up screaming and sweating. I can't leave the house without having a panic attack, feeling like the trauma is happening all over again right in front of my eyes.
